calm-hint: No flashing, strobing or screen shake. Full-screen colour changes stay steady.
color-hint: Adds an outline, a shape or a letter wherever a game uses colour alone to tell things apart.
games-none: No game honours these settings yet.
games-note: Other games play as usual and their runs stay ranked.
hold-hint: Holding a key or button repeats the action, so you do not have to press it again and again.
lede: Assisted runs are kept off the public boards but still count for progress, quests and coins. A run is assisted from the moment it starts, so switching these off mid-run does not put it on a board.
load-failed: Could not load your assists. Reload the page to try again.
page-description: Settings that supporting games honour: calmer visuals, a slower clock and no timed input.
signed-out: Sign in to set your game assists.
speed-hint: Slows the game clock. 100% is normal speed; 50% is half speed.
start-notice: Assists on: this run will not be ranked.
untimed-hint: Removes or extends reaction-time windows and timers. You decide when to go on.
